player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma spanning {num_rounds} rounds.

Game Structure:
- Before each decision you have {total_conversation_rounds} turns to communicate freely.
- After that, both players simultaneously choose to cooperate or defect.

Payoff Matrix (fixed each round):
- Both Cooperate ➜ each {cooperate_reward}
- Both Defect ➜ each {mutual_defect_reward}
- One Defects, one Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

How to Play:
- During conversation: type any text you wish.
- During decision phase: include '[Cooperate]' or '[Defect]' (case-insensitive). You may add extra text before/after the token.

phases.conversation_finished: Tha conaltradh a' dol a dh'fhàgail airson cuairt {round}. Cuir freagairt le '[Cooperate]' no '[Defect]' a dh'fhàsdaichear \boxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: Dealbhaich! Chòrd an dà chluicheadair ri {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Bha an dà chluicheadair a' co-obrachadh.
